author: RohanBhanotAI
text: Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432, CVSS 9.8 remote root, no login needed. Anthropic's AI found the path. ~2.1 million MPTCP-facing servers already being scanned. Ubuntu still shipping the patch late.

author: moftahlmabry
text: 948 ways to get root on Linux, found by AI in one run. OpenAI says a pipeline running an unreleased cyber model reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel bugs, then built 948 distinct local privilege-escalation exploits, each with a candidate patch, for $1.21M in API credits.

author: TechnologyAlign
text: Microsoft says China-linked Storm-0940 abused ConnectWise Cloud Backup in a supply-chain attack, using an AI tool called Artex to automate breaches of hundreds of orgs worldwide.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Researchers observed a supply-chain attack targeting OpenAI Codex users via a malicious GitHub configuration bundle: no executable payload, just natural-language prompt injection silently hijacking the agent's global system prompt.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: Check Point Research: a free Codex jailbreak bundle ships with its own ad inside the agent's trusted files; Check Point names the class 'Prompt Adware'.

author: EmunaEliran
text: ChatGPT Lockdown Mode bypass: entire chat history exfiltrated. Check Point bypassed Lockdown Mode via the HTML preview sandboxed iframes.

author: mergenewsapp
text: Docker Sandboxes vulnerability patched: AI agents could access host files via prompt injection. Update to v0.51.0 (CVE-2026-103916).

author: eyalestrin
text: CVE-2026-116635: path traversal in the deployment status component of the AWS Serverless MCP Server.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-63655: prior to 4.3.1, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server accepts unauthenticated requests.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-76892: prior to 4.3.1, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server calls JSON.parse on untrusted input.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-76893: prior to 4.3.2, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server reuses one stateful session.

author: eric_m_freeman
text: Copilot in Edge picked the scammer 20 out of 20 times: researchers planted one fake review claiming the real provider's cert lapsed, and the agent ruled them out on safety grounds.

author: dd_pwnd
text: LLMjacking: attackers grab cloud AI API keys from leaked code or phishing pages and run victims' AI accounts; one company was hit for $100,000 in a single day.

author: CyfirmaR
text: PHP2Shell is being actively exploited: CVE-2026-109618 + CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2) give unauthenticated RCE in PHP core. Updating your CMS does not fix it. Attribution DPRK/Lazarus-nexus.

author: sheriff_ayinla
text: WordPress sites face an actively exploited flaw, CVE-2026-119977. Update to version 7.1.4 or later.

author: notCVE
text: Actively exploited, added to CISA KEV 2026-11-04: CVE-2024-27834 Apple multiple products improper authentication vulnerability, CVSS 8.8.

author: shah_sheikh
text: Zyxel GS1900 patch fails to block zero-day exploit allowing root command execution (CVE-2026-107441).

author: BytesNora
text: Hackers use n-day exploits in zero-click attacks on iOS and Android devices (CVE-2025-43529, actively exploited).

author: Hitono_Anzen
text: Ninja Forms (500k+ WordPress sites) has an actively exploited XSS, CVE-2026-94504, in 3.15.3 and older, planting a backdoor and hidden admin. Update to 3.15.4+.

author: veenodetech
text: Only one flaw in Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday was exploited in real attacks: CVE-2026-96951, a Windows Shell Mark of the Web bypass.

author: Prashan76506990
text: Reflected XSS in Laravel's debug error page gives full JavaScript execution; confirmed unpatched on 12.x and 13.x (13.39.0).

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: NTT DOCOMO has detected unauthorised external access affecting servers supporting DOCOMO Online Shop and My docomo.

author: ICPLEGEND1966
text: Binance and Deribit have revoked API keys connected to SignalPlus following a potential security issue. Binance says customer funds are safe.

author: XBToshi
text: The GitBook incident: attackers compromising documentation is a wake-up call for Web3.

author: Dave_Joe_9377
text: The PC launcher for Goddess of Victory: NIKKE is suspected of spreading malware, per Korean outlets.

author: grisdoteth
text: Binance's $6.34B breach never needed a private key: fake interviews, a signing service that said yes, and EIP 7702 keeping funds moving after withdrawals paused.
